title: Video Storyboard
description: Create a storyboard for a short video with scene descriptions, camera angles, and timing.
prompt: Create a storyboard for a 60-second promotional video for a fitness app called 'PulseFit'. Include 8 scenes with descriptions, camera angles (wide, medium, close-up), duration for each scene, and suggested background music or sound effects. The video should follow a narrative arc: problem introduction, app demonstration, user testimonial, and call to action.
